title: SpongeBob Party Portal
description: A vibrant cartoon scene shows SpongeBob SquarePants, Sandy Cheeks, and Patrick Star dancing together in front of a stone archway. Through the arch is a starry night sky with a glowing yellow castle, while musical notes, comic panels, and party decorations float around them.
prompt: A vibrant cartoon scene featuring SpongeBob SquarePants with a big smile and red tie dancing in the center, Sandy Cheeks the squirrel on the left in a dynamic pose with red tie, and Patrick Star the green dog-like character on the right wearing a 'JAM SESH' t-shirt and brown pants. They are positioned on stone steps in front of a large brick archway covered in purple flowers and vines. Through the arch is a starry blue night sky with a glowing golden castle on a hill. Floating around them are musical notes, purple and yellow streamers, multiple small comic panels showing various cartoon characters, and jars of jam on the ground. The overall style is colorful, energetic, and celebratory.
